# Schedule Nightly version reporting after archive completion

The Ship-It version-update task depends on post-beetmover-dummy, so it runs after archive upload rather than immediately after a build. It is restricted to Nightly on comm-central and uses shipping-phase ship with a shippable task. Production and staging server scopes differ, while the action scope is explicit. Review changed the loader and job vocabulary to the taskgraph transform loader and task form. The bug also required a scope grant in the separate CI configuration repository; the in-tree string alone cannot grant access. No task graph, archive upload or Ship-It call was executed.

Scope: Release task ordering.
